cases.report: Oriel v1 permits one active writer per database. [1.1]

sources.text: The fictional Oriel database version 1 permits exactly one active writer per database. Readers can run concurrently with that writer. Oriel version 1 is offered under license A or license B, at the user's choice; accepting both is not required. Encryption is disabled by default in Oriel version 1 and can be enabled explicitly. No throughput measurements or network filesystem guarantees are supplied by this manual.
